purpose: Active execution packing for semantic CI obligations; production and scoped rehearsal must preserve this capability ownership.

fast-gate.note: Always-materialized static/validator/lint lane. Node contracts and production build execute independently.

production-build.note: Impact-scoped production bundle lane; independent from validators/lint so build/projection work does not serialize Fast Gate.

deep-verification.note: Coverage-only implementation lane; expensive services are independently packed so they do not serialize behind covered Vitest.

deep-services.note: Independent solver-soundness / persistence lane; selected proofs and Firestore execute concurrently and do not require canonical runtime data.

node-contracts.note: Two-runner Node/CLI matrix. Semantic selection is preserved; execution-owner filters partition the selected commands exactly once across research+solver+game+persistence and shared+data+repo.

finalStatus.note: Router, Fast Gate and Node matrix must succeed; production build, coverage and deep-services may skip only when semantic routing does not select their capabilities.
